ALGER, 12/07/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Le gé: ALGIERS, 07/12/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Chinese technology giant Huawei has launched in Algeria its new MatePad SE with a size of 10.4 inches, designed to offer unparalleled visual comfort thanks to TÜV Rheinland certifications and brightness adjustment on 4096 levels.
Huawei MatePad SE 10,4 pouces : une expé: Huawei MatePad SE 10.4-inch: a redesigned visual experience
Le groupe Huawei a officiellement lancé: The Huawei group has officially launched in Algeria its new flagship product, the Huawei MatePad SE, featuring a 10.4-inch screen specially designed to reduce eye fatigue. This device is based on two TÜV Rheinland certifications, guaranteeing a level of visual comfort in accordance with the strictest international standards. With a brightness adjustment system offering 4,096 levels, the user benefits from perfect adaptation to all lighting conditions, whether indoors or outdoors. According to Huawei Algeria officials, this model is part of an approach aimed at improving the user experience on touch tablets, a booming segment on the national market.
La tablette, disponible en plusieurs cou: The tablet, available in several colors, also includes a high-capacity battery allowing up to 12 hours of autonomy in continuous use. Performance is ensured by an octa-core processor coupled with 4 GB of RAM and 64 GB of expandable storage, offering fluidity suitable for everyday use as well as multimedia applications. Local experts emphasize that this launch aligns with Huawei's strategy to strengthen its presence in the wilayas, particularly through partnerships with Algerian telecom operators, including Mobilis SA and Djezzy.
L'arrivée du Huawei MatePad SE 10,4 pouc: The arrival of the 10.4-inch Huawei MatePad SE on the Algerian market takes place in a context marked by a growing demand for digital equipment, stimulated by government digitalization programs. With a mobile penetration rate exceeding 120% in 2025 and more than 30 million Internet subscribers, Algeria represents a strategic market for terminal manufacturers. This model could help reduce reliance on low-end tablet imports, while positioning Huawei as a key player in the consumer device segment. Observers believe that this launch could also encourage the emergence of new educational and professional uses, particularly in landlocked wilayas where access to efficient digital tools remains limited.
Sur le plan technologique, l'intégration: On a technological level, the integration of TÜV Rheinland certifications and an advanced brightness system could encourage other manufacturers to align their products to similar standards, thus promoting an overall improvement in the quality of locally available equipment. For users, this translates into a reduction in the risk of visual fatigue, a major issue in a country where screens are omnipresent, whether in work spaces or homes. Specialists in the Algerian ICT sector see this initiative as an opportunity to increase public awareness of good practices for using digital terminals.
Contexte du secteur TIC algérien: Context of the Algerian ICT sector
Le marché algérien des technologies de l: The Algerian information and communication technologies (ICT) market is experiencing unprecedented dynamics, driven by massive investments in digital infrastructure. According to the latest data from ARPCE (Post and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority), the mobile penetration rate reached 125% in 2025, with 58 million active lines for a population of 46 million inhabitants. At the same time, the number of Internet subscribers has exceeded 32 million, thanks to projects to expand 4G coverage and the initiatives of the historic operator Algérie Télécom, which has invested more than 150 billion Algerian dinars in the modernization of its fiber optic network.
Dans le cadre du plan numérique 2030, l': As part of the 2030 digital plan, Algeria aims to cover 100% of the national territory with broadband by 2027, an ambitious objective which requires close collaboration between public and private actors. The ARPCE plays a central role in regulating and supervising the sector, particularly ensuring the quality of services and consumer protection. The operators Mobilis SA, Djezzy and Ooredoo, which dominate the mobile market, have also strengthened their offers in terms of data and connected terminals, thus responding to the growing demand of Algerians for efficient and accessible equipment.
Le lancement du Huawei MatePad SE 10,4 p: The launch of the 10.4-inch Huawei MatePad SE has aroused the interest of industry professionals. Mr. Ahmed Benmoussa, CEO of Huawei Algeria, said: “This product embodies our commitment to offering innovative technological solutions adapted to the needs of Algerian consumers. We are proud to contribute to the digital transformation of the country by offering equipment that meets international standards. »
De son côté, M. Rachid Mebtouche, minist: For his part, Mr. Rachid Mebtouche, Minister of Post and Telecommunications, underlined the importance of these launches to accelerate digital inclusion: “Touchscreen tablets like the MatePad SE play a key role in education and electronic administration. Their massive adoption will help reduce the digital divide between wilayas, particularly in rural areas. »
Huawei prévoit d'étendre la disponibilit: Huawei plans to expand the availability of its MatePad SE to all provinces by the end of 2026, with awareness campaigns targeting schools, universities and businesses. The objective is to position this product as a benchmark in terms of visual comfort and performance, while consolidating the brand's presence on the Algerian market. Analysts believe that this launch could be followed by other innovations, particularly in the segments of professional tablets and IoT (Internet of Things) equipment.
Pour les consommateurs, Huawei annonce d: For consumers, Huawei is already announcing special promotions in collaboration with local mobile operators, allowing them to acquire the MatePad SE with unlimited data plans at preferential rates. This strategy aims to democratize access to high-end terminals, while stimulating competition in a rapidly changing market.
